in_marathi.name: समीर
in_marathi.long_meaning: समीर हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A name derived from the Sanskrit word ‘समीरः’ (samīraḥ), meaning ‘admirer’, ‘worshiper’, or ‘lover’. In Hindu mythology, the name is associated with the god Indra, who is known for his passion and courage. It is also believed to bring admiration and love from others.
